reddit.title: Introducing Material Management in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Our new materials management system replaces the old cost badges with a detailed materials sheet for each build tile. Now, you can easily see what resources you have versus what you need, with shortages clearly highlighted. This makes planning your colony's construction much more intuitive. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

posts: Big news for Provincia players! We've revamped how you manage materials for building. Learn more about this update: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Exciting Update: Materials Management in Provincia!
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a new feature in Provincia that enhances your building experience. The previous cost badges have been replaced with a detailed materials management system. Now you can view the resources needed for each build tile at a glance, with shortages clearly indicated. This update aims to streamline your construction process and improve resource management. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
